verdict.rationale: Extend documents an official MCP server ('Using Extend via MCP', confirmed by probe) and an Agent Quickstart, so users can drive the platform in natural language through an AI assistant. Its pricing page also lists a 'Composer & Review Agent', which suggests natural-language agent features, but the pack gives no detail on it. missing for 10: evidence of a first-party natural-language command interface inside the product itself, detail on what Composer does with natural-language input, documentation of which operations work via natural-language prompts over MCP, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
